title: AI Frames Creator
tagline: Platform for creating Frames for Farcaster using AI. You set the frame’s topic, and the platform generates all the necessary code and instantly deploys the application for use in Farcaster.

prizes.title: Best use of Frames on the Superchain

description:
Our project demonstrates how AI can help non-developers create web3 applications without any technical knowledge. 

We use an innovative approach to visualize applications before deploying them to the server. In most similar projects, the logic of web applications is developed alongside the UI, which significantly slows down AI-driven development. 

We’ve found a method to accelerate the process. Users first visually assess the application before the logic code is created, and only then is the code generated with the help of AI agents. This approach allows for the rapid creation of high-quality applications with a predictable design.

As an example, we’ve chosen one type of application, a Quiz. In the future, it could be any application people can imagine, as LLM can generate code for most ideas.

After completing each Quiz, users can set the amount of USDC on the Base network they would like to receive as a donation. In the future, crypto transactions can be integrated into any part of the application using AI and configured for any EVM network.
how_its_made:
As a foundation, we used the Frames technology from Farcaster. We use TypeScript as the core of the project for both the frontend and backend. 

The AI is powered by the OpenAI API. In the future, we plan to incorporate open LLM models with the capability for local deployment.

We use USDC on the Base network for transactions.

We use open-source libraries to visualize the application before generating the code with the help of an AI agent.
